description: This file defines the Duration class within the OpenMRS logic package, representing time durations with various units (seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, months, years). It includes methods to create Duration objects and convert them to days or milliseconds.

classes.name: Duration
classes.description: Represents a duration of time, with methods for conversion and comparison support.

methods.name: getUnits
methods.description: Returns the units of the duration.

methods.name: getDurationInDays
methods.description: Calculates and returns the duration in days.

methods.name: getDurationInMillis
methods.description: Calculates and returns the duration in milliseconds.

methods.name: seconds
methods.description: Creates a Duration object representing a number of seconds.

methods.name: minutes
methods.description: Creates a Duration object representing a number of minutes.

methods.name: hours
methods.description: Creates a Duration object representing a number of hours.

methods.name: days
methods.description: Creates a Duration object representing a number of days.

methods.name: weeks
methods.description: Creates a Duration object representing a number of weeks.

methods.name: months
methods.description: Creates a Duration object representing a number of months.

methods.name: years
methods.description: Creates a Duration object representing a number of years.
